features.title: Read complete large files through real paginated windows
lessons: Files over the 100k-character tool read limit break every in-place edit path
features.gap: The SDK truncates the whole file before the runtime applies line offsets. LEARNINGS line 1750 exists but is beyond the truncated prefix, so a valid offset returns empty. Preserve bounded responses by selecting the requested window at the filesystem boundary.
acceptance: An offset beyond the first 100k characters returns the real requested lines through the production SDK/runtime path.
The selected response remains capped; traversal, ignored-file and 10MB safety rules remain enforced.
Overlapping paginated reads reconstruct the complete file with a matching SHA-256.

evidence.reason: getFiles caps the original content before returning it.
handleReadFiles applies sliceLines after requestFiles returns.

features.title: Carry compression policy and model context into child agents
lessons: A new AgentState field is not a free edit — the compiler makes you classify it
An embedded scope cannot import — give it data-shaped seams
A marker that names a possibility is not a locator
features.gap: The parent disables micro-compaction, but the child extractor does not forward compression or contextWindow. The child uses default compaction and a 200k context fallback, clearing fetched paper records from model context at 11% of the threshold.
acceptance: Both child spawn paths preserve the configured microCompact:false and evidence-retention settings.
A same-model child receives the resolved context window; a different-model child resolves its own window.
A live-style scholarly sequence retains early paper records through synthesis with micro-compaction disabled.

evidence.reason: The compactor consumes those fields at child loop initialization.

features.title: Prove durable save and resume with nested runtime state
lessons: A retry that re-emits the same oversized tool call is not recovery
A suppression key that can legitimately be null cannot distinguish "inactive" from "active with no identity"
features.gap: Six database snapshot saves failed with cyclic serialization in the surrounding acceptance session. Diagnose the exact field and compare filesystem and database persistence before choosing a repair; database failures alone do not prove all resume state was lost.
acceptance: A nested child-agent run saves and restores semantically equivalent conversation state.
A cyclic transient field produces a bounded diagnostic and preserves durable user content.
Fault injection proves what survives a failed write and whether retry recovers.

evidence.reason: The database save catches the reported failure; authoritative filesystem persistence is separate.
Serialization omits a fixed set of transient keys; the actual uncovered cycle needs identification.

features.title: Recover retained research evidence on demand
lessons: A marker that names a possibility is not a locator
A suite can be passing because of the defect it is named after
features.gap: First repair policy propagation, then assess whether the existing evidence spill/inventory can restore fetched paper records after intentional compaction. Do not create a second evidence store or claim that retained bytes were destroyed merely because model context changed.
acceptance: A compacted result has a resolvable locator with truthful retention bounds.
An authorized researcher can retrieve the original fetched record without rerunning the service.
Missing or expired evidence is reported as a gap, never synthesized from memory.

evidence.reason: Generic scholarly results become compacted placeholders.

features.title: Record production acceptance separately from agent tool success
lessons: The test renderer is not a proxy for the production renderer
A FID's Verification section is a contract — each promised test must exist before "verified"
Law 4 is satisfied by the caller, not by the test that imports the module
features.gap: The agent report confirms tool calls but explicitly does not observe terminal rendering or recovery. Define a run-bound acceptance record that separates model observations, operator UI checks and automated regression evidence.
acceptance: Every claimed UI behavior has an operator/native observation or remains unverified.
Exact run identifiers bind the call ledger, failures and fallback steps.
Resize, input responsiveness, folding, copy/export and resumed-history fidelity have separate outcomes.

evidence.reason: Reviewed acceptance gaps and log correlation.
Existing deliberate-error regressions must remain distinct from live acceptance.

features.title: Detect stale lesson guidance against current executable authority
lessons: An archived walkthrough is a claim — ground the plan in the current contract modules
A ledger ruling inherits the freshness of its evidence
A policy scrub must sweep the rule text and its generator anchors, not just the artifacts
features.gap: Historical lessons retain outdated local-commit authority and platform proposals. Preserve their evidence while identifying current authority and supersession; do not present dated active flags as proof that work remains unimplemented.
acceptance: Historical guidance is visibly distinguished from current protocol authority.
Source changes invalidate reviewed readiness without automatically changing policy.
A stale proposal cannot create duplicate work when a real implemented FID already owns it.

evidence.reason: Existing syntax, supersession and stable-reference validator to extend.
Existing canonical authority catalog to retain and ground.
